summary: The deliverable shows a significant number of instruments with incomplete tag numbers, primarily missing loop numbers. This leads to generic service descriptions and hinders data usability. A specific issue with line tag extraction was also noted. While some full tags are extracted correctly, the high volume of 'type-only' detections requires immediate attention to improve OCR/NLP for full tag block recognition.

comments.evidence_needed: P&ID review to identify the full tag number.
